So how did Lula come from behind to defeat Bolsonaro?

In short, turnout.

Bolsonaro's vote share barely moved. But Lula banked millions of votes from those who didn't vote in the first round & won eliminated candidates' votes.

A remarkable mobilisation. Second round turnout is usually below first.
